page_title: AgentForge: Open Source AI Agent Framework for Building Cognitive Architectures

summary.name: AgentForge
summary.one_liner: AgentForge is an open source AI agent framework for building customizable agents, cognitive architectures, and multi-agent systems.
use_cases: Building customer service agents that escalate complex issues
Automating literature reviews and research data collection
Generating blog posts and marketing copy with consistent style
Automating business workflows that need decision-making
Creating synthetic datasets for training or testing
Building custom chatbots with distinct personas
summary.what_it_does: AgentForge provides a framework for creating specialized AI agents with a flexible architecture. It offers tools and custom actions to extend agent capabilities, and a persona system to define agent personalities and behaviors. Storage options are included to maintain agent state and data. It also lets users sequence multiple prompts or agents for complex tasks, and includes utility functions and an API framework for integrating with existing systems.
notable: Persona management system for defining agent personalities and tone
Cognitive architectures that chain multiple prompts or agents
Pluggable storage for agent state and context
caveats: Page gives few technical details on language, installation, or supported LLM providers
Platform support beyond the web is not stated
